description: Complete byte-stream/BYOB packages consuming the canonical franken_engine Web stream owner, buffer transfer and text codec. Run with the existing project_compat_runner.py and real runtime binaries. Synthetic trusted fixture packages, not registry installs or native parity evidence. No alternate execution backend.

cases.description: An actual file-backed package producer fills caller-owned views; the consumer preserves a below-minimum final read before publishing the complete file.
A conditional ESM package fills a typed consumer through reexported core constructors, using transferred response views at nonzero offsets.

files.streams.mjs: export {ReadableStreamBYOBReader as Reader,ReadableByteStreamController as Controller,ReadableStreamBYOBRequest as Request} from 'node:stream/web';

cases.description: One byte producer feeds a mutating BYOB binary consumer and the shared incremental text decoder without corrupting either output.
Cancelling an unfulfilled read releases the reader result but the operation waits for a package cleanup promise before publishing its receipt.
An incomplete multi-byte record fails the read and closed promise with the same error; a published file remains unchanged and a new valid source can still complete.
